ayahs.translation: Lo! Man is in a state of loss;

ayahs.arabicText: اِلَّا الَّذِیْنَ اٰمَنُوْا وَ عَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ وَ تَوَاصَوْا بِالْحَقِّ١ۙ۬ وَ تَوَاصَوْا بِالصَّبْرِ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: save those who have faith and do righteous deeds, and counsel each other to hold on to truth and counsel each other to be steadfast.
